name: Shine Post: Be Your Idol!
storyline:
After seeing the live concert of the legendary idol Hotaru, you are moved and become determined to support idols attain their dreams.

Years later, you successfully establish your own talent agency. Alongside your consultant Izumino Koyume and the idols you chose at auditions, you start your journey as a new manager and proprietor.

With the goal of having a successful concert at Budokan Hall in 3 years, can you attain your goal and continue to support the dreams of your idols?
summary: Shine Post: Be Your Idol! is a Japanese idol-raising game and part of the Shine Post multimedia franchise. The game features an original story and also includes scenarios based on the anime and novels stories.
